purpose: Create a new ECS cluster with optional capacity-provider bindings + default strategy.

flags.name: --capacity-providers
flags.doc: Bind one or more (e.g., FARGATE FARGATE_SPOT, or a custom EC2-ASG-backed CP).

flags.name: --default-capacity-provider-strategy
flags.doc: Default for run-task without explicit strategy.

examples.invocation: aws ecs create-cluster --cluster-name prod --capacity-providers FARGATE FARGATE_SPOT --default-capacity-provider-strategy capacityProvider=FARGATE,base=2,weight=1 capacityProvider=FARGATE_SPOT,weight=9

purpose: Update capacity-provider bindings on an existing cluster (atomic — must include the full list).

examples.invocation: aws ecs put-cluster-capacity-providers --cluster prod --capacity-providers FARGATE FARGATE_SPOT my-asg-cp --default-capacity-provider-strategy capacityProvider=FARGATE,weight=1

purpose: Create an EC2-ASG-backed capacity provider with managed-scaling parameters.

flags.name: --auto-scaling-group-provider
flags.doc: Bind to ASG; ECS drives scaling via CapacityProviderReservation metric.

examples.scenario: Wire ECS to drive an EC2 ASG

purpose: Resolve the latest ECS-Optimized AMI ID for a variant. Use in CloudFormation/Terraform for always-fresh AMIs.
